title: Live structured browser actuation
objective: Bind Quntal's existing structured browser click/fill authority to the live governed browser engine. Every live action must revalidate exact page, origin, page/document generation, node identity, role/state, workspace/policy revision, and approval immediately before execution, then observe a bounded postcondition and deterministically advance or invalidate state. Structured denial never silently falls back to coordinates.

include: live click/invoke on one server-issued live node whose role/state permit invoke
live bounded non-password fill on one server-issued text-compatible node
fresh SOFT approval and one-shot digest binding preserved from the existing browser actuation contract
immediate pre-execution revalidation of page, origin, page/document generation, node role/state, workspace/trust/policy revision, and host identity
bounded postcondition observation and deterministic page/document generation updates after mutation
tests for stale/replaced nodes, disabled/role mismatch, navigation races, document mutation races, approval replay/expiry/digest mismatch, host crash, cancellation, and double execution

authority_delta.process: None beyond the existing governed browser host.
authority_delta.network: Page effects remain within SG-000075 browser egress policy.
authority_delta.browser: Existing structured click/fill authority becomes live against exact typed nodes.
authority_delta.ui_input: No OS-level mouse/keyboard authority is added; actuation occurs through the browser engine on structured node identity.
authority_delta.secrets: Password targets and browser credential stores remain denied; fill values are bounded caller-supplied non-secret text under the existing evidence rules.
authority_delta.approval: Fresh one-shot SOFT approval remains mandatory for each click/fill mutation.

invariants: structured browser mutation is exact-node and fresh-state bound
approval is consumed once before mutation and cannot be replayed
structured failure never silently widens to coordinate input
password targets, raw JS/CDP, personal profiles, and OS-level input remain unreachable

acceptance.claim: Live click and fill execute only on exact current nodes whose bound role/state/page/origin/document/workspace/policy facts still match immediately before execution.
Stale/replaced/disabled/wrong-role nodes, navigation/document races, approval replay/expiry/digest mismatch, cancellation, and host failure all fail closed without duplicate mutation.
Postcondition observation and generation advancement make prior node identities stale deterministically where the document/page changed.
No password fill, coordinate fallback, OS input, raw JS/CDP, personal-profile, transfer bypass, or remote reach is introduced.
Exact-head live-browser tests, CI, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, security review, and zero unresolved blockers pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000078: Live browser transfers may activate only after structured mutation semantics are canonically qualified.

done_when: Structured browser click/fill are live and canonically qualified with exact-node revalidation, one-shot approval, postconditions, race handling, and no silent coordinate widening.
